title: N -W F P Tenancy Amendment Act 1992

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Tenancy Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XI OF 1992
ACT XI OF 1992
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE TENANCY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to amend the
North-West Frontier Province Tenancy Act, 1950
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary,
16th December, 1992]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/92/23973, dated
16-12-1992.--The North-West Frontier Province Tenancy (Amendment) Bill, 1992,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 13th December, 1992 and assented to by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 14th December, 1992, is hereby published,
as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and commencement.--(l) This Act may be called the
North-West Frontier Province Tenancy (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 23rd day of March, 1990.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Tenancy Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4 of N.W.F.P. Act XXV of 1950

ACT XI OF 1992
ACT XI OF 1992
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE TENANCY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to amend the
North-West Frontier Province Tenancy Act, 1950
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary,
16th December, 1992]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/92/23973, dated
16-12-1992.--The North-West Frontier Province Tenancy (Amendment) Bill, 1992,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 13th December, 1992 and assented to by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 14th December, 1992, is hereby published,
as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
2. Amendment of section 4 of N.-W.F.P. Act XXV of 1950.--In the
North West Frontier Province Tenancy Act, 1950 (N.-W.F.P. Act XXV of 1950), hereinafter
referred to as the said Act, for section 4, the following shall be substituted,
namely:--
'4. Rights of ownership of certain persons.--Any
occupancy tenant, who had the right of occupancy in the land so occupied by him
under section.5(1)(c) of the Punjab Tenancy Act, 1887, or who may prove by a
reliable, clear and un ambiguous evidence, before a Court of competent
jurisdiction, that he is the real owner, according to Shariah, of the' land
under his tenancy, and who occupies any land as such, shall become full owner
of such land without payment of any compensation to the landlord and shall
acquire it free from any encumbrance created in respect of that land by the
landlord:'.
